name: FLArE
summary: FLArE is proposed for CERN's Forward Physics Facility west of ATLAS. This multipurpose forward-neutrino and light-dark-matter detector has published projected event yields and sensitivity curves.
detection_principle: A far-forward liquid-argon TPC uses detailed three-dimensional tracking and calorimetry to identify isolated forward electrons from dark-matter–electron scattering and distinguish high-energy neutrino and muon backgrounds.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
